entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, this VeloBand you sold me is a complete piece of junk! It's not working and I want my money back immediately. This is ridiculous.
I'm very sorry to hear you're experiencing trouble with your device. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Are you kidding me? It's broken! It's defective! The pulse monitor is all over the place, it won't sync with my phone, and half the time it doesn't even turn on. I want a refund, not a 20-questions quiz.
I understand your frustration, and I apologize for the inconvenience. Let me just pull up your account details... Okay, I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker was delivered to you 22 days ago.
I don't care if it was 22 days or 22 minutes ago! You sold me a defective product. I want a manager on the phone right now, or I swear I will light up every review site on the internet about this.
That won't be necessary. I can definitely help you with this. One moment while I review our return policy for you.
Okay, I've just checked, and I have good news. You are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh. Wait, really? Just like that? You're going to issue the refund?

Yes, absolutely. Since the item is defective, I'm processing that for you now. I've just emailed a prepaid return shipping label to you. As soon as we receive the broken band back at our warehouse, your refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Huh. Okay, well... that's what I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
